name: octopus-2
description: Octopus Sovereign Edition — self-evolving AI agent system with 23 tools. Zero-Key auth, Sovereign Fallback to local Ollama, 14 specialist agents.

tools.name: octopus_plan_task
tools.description: Ask Cortex to break down a complex task into an execution plan of specialized agents.

tools.name: octopus_run_task_chain
tools.description: Run the entire dynamic Octopus agent chain (Cortex planning + all needed agents + gate verification + session compact).

tools.name: octopus_search_memory
tools.description: Query the L1 structural graph memory to find relevant indexed files and their architectural context.

tools.name: octopus_get_decisions
tools.description: Retrieve past architectural decisions and risk flags from L2 memory.

tools.name: octopus_compact_session
tools.description: Compress current workspace context into long-term memory at the end of an LLM session.

tools.name: octopus_execute_command
tools.description: Execute arbitrary OS commands in the workspace (e.g., npm run test).

tools.name: octopus_write_file
tools.description: Write raw content to a file in the workspace.

tools.name: octopus_read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file in the workspace.

tools.name: octopus_create_agent
tools.description: Dynamically create and hot-reload a new Octopus agent into the active registry.

tools.name: octopus_scan_security
tools.description: Scan an array of file paths for cyberthreats and vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).

tools.name: octopus_llm_complete
tools.description: Send a prompt to the active LLM provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or Ollama) and return the completion.

tools.name: octopus_browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the agent-browser and return a page snapshot with element refs.

tools.name: octopus_browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility tree snapshot from the active browser session. Returns element refs (@e1, @e2 …).

tools.name: octopus_skill_scout
tools.description: Trigger MarketScout to scan GitHub, npm, and PyPI for skill opportunities and deprecations.

tools.name: octopus_skill_synthesize
tools.description: Toolsmith reads a documentation URL and synthesizes a new MCP skill (code + schema). Deploys to sandbox for QA.

tools.name: octopus_skill_validate
tools.description: Run SandboxQA on a synthesized skill. Self-corrects via Toolsmith on failure (up to 3 attempts).

tools.name: octopus_skill_deploy
tools.description: CEO deploys a sandbox-validated skill to the active registry. Retires any skill it supersedes.

tools.name: octopus_skill_retire
tools.description: Retire an active skill from the marketplace registry.

tools.name: octopus_skill_list
tools.description: List all skills in the marketplace registry with their status and QA results.

tools.name: octopus_browser_interact
tools.description: Interact with the active browser page: click, fill, type, or eval JavaScript.

tools.name: octopus_login
tools.description: Zero-Key authentication: opens an interactive terminal menu (enquirer) to authorize a provider. Three paths: Anthropic API key, OpenAI API key, Google API key, or Vertex AI/Bedrock setup instructions. Keys are stored in the OS Vault (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service) — no .env editing required.

tools.name: octopus_vault_check
tools.description: Diagnostic: check which LLM providers have keys stored in the OS Vault or session file, and whether local Ollama is running. Reports the active provider and whether Sovereign Fallback is engaged.

tools.name: octopus_memory_status
tools.description: Diagnostic: ping the Python memory service (port 5000) and return its health status. Use this to verify the service is running before running agent task chains.

prerequisite: Python memory service must be running on port 5000 before starting this server.
